(exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 93/2023 of PS Vasant Kunj for the offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that they have compromised the disputes with complainant de facto (respondent no. 2 herein).
3.

Vide order dated 06.05.2025, the Joint Registrar (Judicial) directed placing of this matter before this Court since the respondent no. 2 stated that she did not want to get the matter quashed because there are certain issues regarding the stridhan which have not been settled.
